rationale.text: A link's only content is an img with an empty alt, and the link has no aria-label, aria-labelledby or title. The glossary builds an image link's name from the text alternative of its image, which here is empty, and there is no text; the content gives no name, as the wording requires between and . The custom check computes an empty name from content and faults the link (step 6), so the finding is failed at both levels.
